# Beacon Provider

Manage Beacon (https://usebeacon.pro) status pages, components, monitors and webhooks through the REST API v1.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    beacon = {
      source = "shaferllc/beacon"
    }
  }
}

# Token from BEACON_API_TOKEN, URL from BEACON_URL (default https://usebeacon.pro).
provider "beacon" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `token` (String, Sensitive) Workspace API token (`bchk_…`) with the `write` scope. Defaults to the `BEACON_API_TOKEN` environment variable.
- `url` (String) Beacon base URL. Defaults to the `BEACON_URL` environment variable, then `https://usebeacon.pro`.
